style: Gritty modern flat vector illustration in graphite (#141414), electric orange (#ff7a00) and off-white, bold industrial shapes, no text. No hands, no people.
hero: A compact urban workshop at night: a car on a lift, orange-lit tool wall, a tire tread pattern painted on the floor, a rolling cart. Flat vector, DARK graphite overall, electric-orange highlights. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people.
